title: Resolution urging Congress to protect military widows' benefits after remarriage
summary: This resolution calls on Congress to pass and the President to sign H.R.1004, the Love Lives On Act, which would stop the Department of Defense from cutting off Survivor Benefit Plan payments to a surviving military spouse just because they remarry. It cites data showing many of New York City's roughly 131,000 veterans and their surviving spouses rely on this benefit and often avoid remarrying to keep it.
